note: The Bahamas issues no national identity card: its government is building a national digital identity, which it describes as a step it is advancing rather than a completed system (ID Tech, 16 June 2026, reporting the Minister of Innovation and National Development).

sources.title: ID Tech, Bahamas Advances National Digital ID as Foundation for Government Services (16 June 2026)
sources.said: The Bahamas government is moving ahead with a national digital identity system intended to give citizens and businesses a single secure credential for accessing government services and verifying who they are. ... The government describes the national digital ID, AI law, and skills drive as steps it is advancing rather than completed systems,
